name: Sector ETF Performance During High Inflation (>4% YoY CPI)
description: Identifies periods where YoY CPI inflation exceeds 4% and measures sector ETF (XLE, XLK, XLF, XLP) total return performance during those periods. Shows average return by sector, hit rates, and marks inflation regime entries.
source:
# ============================================================================
# Sector ETF Performance During High Inflation (>4% YoY CPI)
# Identifies contiguous periods where YoY CPI > 4%, computes per-period
# total return for each sector ETF, and aggregates statistics.
# ============================================================================

# --- Data ---
src = study_assets()
ts = index().value

# CPI: monthly sparse series
cpi_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="CPIAUCSL").result

# YoY CPI on sparse monthly data: current / 12-months-ago - 1
# Use is_valid to detect monthly prints, then valuewhen for 12th prior print
had_cpi = is_valid(cpi_raw)
cpi_12m_ago = valuewhen(had_cpi, cpi_raw, occurrence=12)
# Compute YoY only on months where we have both current and 12m-ago
yoy_cpi_sparse = where(had_cpi and is_valid(cpi_12m_ago), (cpi_raw / cpi_12m_ago) - 1.0)
# Forward fill to daily
yoy_cpi = ffill(yoy_cpi_sparse)

# --- Inflation Regime Detection ---
# Regime: YoY CPI > 4%
threshold = 0.04
is_high_inflation = yoy_cpi > threshold
is_entry = crossover(yoy_cpi, threshold)
is_exit = crossunder(yoy_cpi, threshold)

# --- Per-Period Performance ---
# Close at most recent regime entry
entry_close = valuewhen(is_entry, src.c, occurrence=0)

# Period return at exit: (exit_close / entry_close) - 1
period_return = where(is_exit, (src.c / entry_close) - 1.0)

# Period length in bars (days) at exit
period_length_days = where(is_exit, barssince(is_entry))

# Hit rate: 1 if positive return, 0 if not, only at exit bars
hit_flag = where(is_exit, 1.0 if (is_valid(period_return) and period_return > 0) else 0.0)

# --- Event Markers: Inflation Regime Entry ---
# Show YoY CPI level at entry
cpi_at_entry = where(is_entry, yoy_cpi)

event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title='Inflation > 4% Entry',
    icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title='YoY CPI', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1,
                   card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
        ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))((yoy_cpi, is_entry))

# --- Chart: Average Total Return by Sector ---
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Avg Sector Return During Inflation >4% Periods',
    x_axis_label='Sector ETF',
    y_axis_label='Avg Total Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    sort_by_value=SortByValue.Descending,
    color_by_value=True,
    data_labels=True,
    category='Inflation Regime Analysis',
    order=1
)(values=period_return)

# --- Table: Summary Statistics by Sector ---
cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Sector Performance During High Inflation Periods',
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Sector Performance During High Inflation Periods',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Total Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Median Total Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Median),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit Rate', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='# Inflation Periods', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Count),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Period Length (days)', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean)
        ]
    ),
    category='Inflation Regime Analysis',
    order=2
)((period_return, period_return, hit_flag, period_return, period_length_days))
